name: Subagent Config
description: Edit the @tintinweb/pi-subagents configuration from the browser: agent files across all three discovery layers and subagents.json, with model pins validated against the model store so an unresolvable pin cannot silently inherit the parent session model.

build.command: npx --no-install esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=es2022 --packages=external --outfile=index.mjs && npx --no-install esbuild src/client.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=esm --target=es2022 --loader:.css=text --external:./vendor/* --outfile=client/entry.mjs
